original_idea.body:
# Measuring Whether the $10M OpenAI Cyber Defense Grant Actually Changes the Offense-Defense Balance

**Problem:** OpenAI's $10M defensive AI grant program is described as a market mechanism for dual-use governance, but no evaluation framework exists to assess whether it will actually reduce the offense-defense gap.

**Direction:** Define metrics for evaluating grant program effectiveness (number of funded defensive tools, capability benchmark improvements, defender access rate changes, real-world incident response time improvements). Analyze the grant program criteria and prioritization. Assess whether the selection criteria would fund work that moves the needle on Potter et al.'s offense-defense gap.

**Why it matters:** If the grant program funds defensive work that doesn't address the structural capability gap, it is governance theater. This analysis provides an evaluation framework before results are available.

**Relevant context:** OpenAI $10M Cybersecurity Grant Program; Potter et al. offense-defense gap; RAND benchmark governance.
